notes.decision: Fits with guardrails. Workspace > Ward remains the canonical home for kennel and foster occupancy. Routine placement is visible; release and roster maintenance use separate disclosures. No navigation layer or second animal-management route is added.
notes.persona: A kennel technician or shelter manager needs to see free capacity and correct an animal's placement without knowing Resource or allocation schema vocabulary.
notes.reuse: The existing Ward map/list, Surface, shared form primitives, and canonical Resource read model are extended. No dashboard, metric primitive, status-color map, or duplicate data authority is introduced.
notes.sourceTruth: Resource owns housing kind, label, capacity, block and lifecycle; ResourceCapacityAllocation owns the append-preserving stay; the Ward projection owns combined counts.
notes.states: No housing points to Housing setup without claiming zero capacity. No open destination explains unblock/add/release recovery. Shared SubmitButton and FormStatus expose pending, success, validation, permission, and conflict outcomes.
notes.aiBoundary: No control sends a coworker prompt. Every action is a direct governed server command with server-derived tenancy.
notes.verification: Focused component, route, repository, occupancy, Ward, and archetype tests plus typecheck; governed desktop and 390px browser verification is required before merge. All color roles use existing DPF tokens and interactive targets use the shared control scale.
